title: From Petra back to Makka — From ‘Pibla’ back to Qibla
description: The principal scholarly rejection of Gibson's hypothesis. King grants the early mosques do not face the Hijazi Mecca geographically, but explains their orientations by folk-astronomical 'sacred geography' (alignment to stars, winds, and cardinal directions toward the Kaʿba) rather than aiming at Petra.

cited_by.title: The First Mosques Faced Petra, Not Mecca
